* 
* %Identification
* Written by: Python McStas Instrument Generator
* Date: 13:50:59 on August 25, 2026
* Origin: ESS DMSC
* %INSTRUMENT_SITE: Generated_instruments
* 
* !!Please write a short instrument description (1 line) here!!
* 
* %Description
* Please write a longer instrument description here!
* 
* 
* %Parameters
* r_pin1: [unit] m] radius of first pinhole at 3m
* r_pin2: [unit] m] radius of second pinhole at 6m
* lambda0: [unit] Angstrom
* dlambda: [unit] Angstrom
* 
* %Link 
* 
* %End 
********************************************************************************/

DEFINE INSTRUMENT t2_sans_collimation (
r_pin1 = 0.005, // m] radius of first pinhole at 3m
r_pin2 = 0.005, // m] radius of second pinhole at 6m
lambda0 = 6.0, // Angstrom
dlambda = 0.05 // Angstrom
)

DECLARE 
%{
%}

INITIALIZE 
%{
// Start of initialize for generated t2_sans_collimation
%}

TRACE 
COMPONENT source = Source_simple(
 radius = 0.02, dist = 3.0,
 focus_xw = 2*r_pin1, focus_yh = 2*r_pin1,
 lambda0 = lambda0, dlambda = dlambda)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT pin1 = Slit(
 radius = r_pin1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 3.0) RELATIVE source

COMPONENT pin2 = Slit(
 radius = r_pin2)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 6.0) RELATIVE source

COMPONENT lambda_mon = L_monitor(
 nL = 100, filename = "lambda_mon.dat",
 xwidth = 0.05, yheight = 0.05,
 Lmin = 5.0, Lmax = 7.0,
 restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.01) RELATIVE pin2

COMPONENT sample = Sans_spheres(
 R = 100.0, Phi = 0.001,
 Delta_rho = 0.6, sigma_abs = 0.05,
 xwidth = 0.01, yheight = 0.01,
 zdepth = 0.001, target_index = 2,
 focus_r = 0.42)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.05) RELATIVE pin2

COMPONENT beamstop = Beamstop(
 radius = 0)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 1.0) RELATIVE sample

COMPONENT detector = PSD_monitor(
 nx = 128, ny = 128,
 filename = "detector.dat", xwidth = 0.6,
